articles.title: Why bitcoin’s recent climb to $80,000 might just be a temporary liquidity squeeze
articles.snippet: Spot ETF outflows and a hawkish Federal Reserve are creating a "macro ceiling" that makes a new all-time high unlikely without a major geopolitical shift.

articles.title: Law firm Fenwick & West sued for $525M over alleged role in FTX collapse
articles.snippet: Twenty FTX victims are suing Fenwick & West, claiming the law firm didn’t just represent FTX, it helped build the infrastructure that kept the fraud running.

articles.title: ChatGPT Is Losing Ground to Rivals—Here Are Some Numbers
articles.snippet: ChatGPT's web traffic share is falling while its rivals are rising—just as businesses start to look beyond OpenAI.

articles.title: 'Lord of the Rings' Director Peter Jackson Says AI Is 'Just a Special Effect'
articles.snippet: Peter Jackson says Hollywood’s fears around AI could hurt recognition for performance-capture acting, as debates about how the technology will reshape the movie industry grow.

articles.title: Half of AI Health Advice Is Wrong—And Seems Just Right
articles.snippet: A peer-reviewed audit in BMJ Open found that nearly 50% of health responses from five major AI chatbots were problematic, with fabricated sources and confident delivery.
